control.learner: exact fixed shallow HistGradientBoostingRegressor from PR31/PR34
control.chronology: exact PR31/PR34 folds, delay, hold and purge

challenger_information.source: exact normalized cache emitted by PR40 source gate
challenger_information.join_rule: for every signal session, only SEC facts with filed <= signal date are visible
challenger_information.duration_fact_policy: source coverage may be retained, but these facts are excluded from this first consumer because duration disambiguation requires a separately frozen parser; no post-outcome inclusion

comparability.instant_fact_selection: within each accession/category select the row with latest period end; when multiple rows share the period end require one value after exact duplicate collapse
comparability.prior_annual_comparable: most recent earlier filed observation with period end approximately one fiscal year earlier (330-400 days); unavailable values remain missing and are not imputed from future filings
comparability.model_rows: challenger is evaluated only where all five predeclared fundamental features are finite; control is re-evaluated on the exact same rows

interpretation: each path head independently earns or rejects this modality; a passing head does not force the same information into other heads and does not define a trading utility
